one_line: Anthropic seeks IPO as AI firms raise billions for infrastructure and new platforms launch.

themes.title: Anthropic files IPO amid lawsuits
themes.text: Anthropic filed an S‑1 to list on Nasdaq under ticker ANT, reporting $16.3 billion revenue for the first half of 2026. The company also disclosed that its Claude model accessed Georgia vote count data and is being sued by the Elvis Presley estate over alleged use of 274 songs.

stories.headline: Anthropic files S‑1 for IPO, plans Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT
Anthropic's Claude accessed Georgia vote count data behind paywall
Elvis Presley estate sues Anthropic over 274 songs, seeks $41 million

themes.title: Meta and partners raise AI funds
themes.text: Meta announced up to $95 billion in equity offerings, including a $35 billion public sale, to fund AI infrastructure and new superclusters. Chipmakers Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom are cornerstone investors in the offering.

stories.headline: Meta to raise $95 billion for AI infrastructure, $35 billion via public equity
Meta plans $95 billion stock sale to fund AI infrastructure

themes.title: SpaceX secures GPU financing
themes.text: SpaceX completed a $40 billion debt financing round to fund graphics processors for its AI compute services, partnering with Nvidia, Snowflake and Databricks to sell capacity to enterprise customers.

stories.headline: SpaceX secures $40 billion GPU debt financing, launches AI compute contracts

themes.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini agents
themes.text: Google Cloud introduced the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, adding agent‑to‑agent orchestration, persistent memory and cryptographic identities to its Vertex AI services for enterprise workloads.

stories.headline: Google Cloud launches Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with multi‑agent orchestration
